title: "Just get up and walk out": Elon Musk’s unusual meeting rule for Tesla employees
summary_full: Elon Musk underscores the significance of productivity during meetings, urging team members to exit if they feel unable to contribute. He views long meetings as a hindrance and advocates for shorter, more impactful sessions. Additionally, Musk pushes for transparent communication among employees, encouraging messages to circumvent hierarchical protocols. Clarity in language, free from jargon, is also stressed to boost efficiency.
